scope: Track A screens: Today, Engine (Network, Flow, Decisions, Table), Book (Position, Risk & Finance, Ledger), shell controls on those screens
method: e2e/audit-controls.mjs clicks every control on a fresh page load, records requests, dialogs, URL and DOM change, console and page errors; e2e/regression-trackA.mjs verifies user journeys
statuses: PASS = acted, effect observed, no console/page/HTTP error; FAIL = error or no observable effect; BLOCKED = destructive or external, covered by a targeted check; NOT APPLICABLE = disabled or hidden in that state

journeys.name: a screen crash shows the recovery message instead of a blank app
the navigation is still on screen after the crash
moving to another screen clears the crash message
the question is sent to the backend
the answer is rendered, and it is about who owes money
a blank question sends nothing
a failed request shows an error message, not a fake answer
retrying after the failure works
a 401 mid-session returns to the sign-in page
after signing in again the person lands back on the page they were on
a recommended option is marked
the option opens as a what-if in the Engine
the RISK command opens Book, Risk & Finance
the M key toggles Munim
each of the 5 alerts in the bell leads somewhere (a screen or the party drawer)
logging a missed entry confirms it
the miss shows in the per-check tally after the data refreshes
Export CSV downloads a real CSV with the ledger data
the arrow keys move the timeline one day at a time
Space starts playback and the button says Pause
playback advanced while playing and stays put after Pause
Home returns to day 0
N jumps to the next issue
recording a payment from Today stores exactly one transaction, even on a double click
the paid bill leaves "Do today"
repeated payments show up as two flagged entries
"Looks fine" removes the flag from the list
"It is real" keeps it, under confirmed issues
the check tally counts one real, one fine
a denied microphone gives a clear message and a way to dismiss it
journeys.detail: ["Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site in the browser's address bar, then try again.","Dismiss"]

journeys.name: invalid day counts are refused on screen without calling the engine
the form says what is wrong in words
